The slow_increment_ratio and slow_increment_C3_ratio lemmas are conditional (they need hz) rpow identities. They are used only as explicit rewrites (`rw`, `simpa only`), and making them simp lemmas would not help, so I raised no simp finding on them. Likewise lowJet_increment_eq_variation is a one-use bridge lemma. The one concrete problem is the position lemma, which sits outside the existing simp interface and is unused. findings.problem: The file proves that the position slots of a low-jet increment vanish. It states this as a raw coordinate application `(… - …) (.inl i) = 0`, and its proof only works by `change` to the unfolded definition (`lowJet … (.inl i) = x i` by defeq). The repo's canonical simp interface for position slots is `lowJetPosition` with the simp lemmas `lowJetPosition_apply`, `lowJetPosition_lowJet` and `lowJetPosition_variationLowJet`. There is no simp lemma for `lowJet G p (.inl i) = p i`, so this fact is outside that interface. `lowJetPosition_apply` rewrites `lowJetPosition J i` into `J (.inl i)`, so `simp` turns the position form into the raw form this lemma is stated in. Nothing in the rest of the repo calls the lemma, and it is not tagged `@[simp]`. The same fact is therefore a hand-proved, non-simp duplicate. A user would have to know to `change` through the definition instead of `simp`.
findings.proposed_change: Either delete the unused lemma, or move it into the position-slot API in SpatialLoopAmplitude.lean in the form `lowJetPosition (lowJet (fun y => G y + H y) x - lowJet G x) = 0`. That form should follow from `map_sub`, `lowJetPosition_lowJet` and `sub_self`. If the raw coordinate form is wanted, add a single `@[simp] lemma lowJet_apply_inl (G) (p) (i) : lowJet G p (.inl i) = p i := rfl` next to `lowJet` in LowJetChainRule.lean. Then `(lowJet _ x - lowJet G x) (.inl i) = 0` closes by `simp`, because `Pi.sub_apply` and `sub_self` already apply.
findings.benefit: Position-slot facts about jets would be proved by `simp` through one canonical rule, rather than by `change` on the definition's unfolding. There would be no unused, unregistered duplicate lemma competing with the `lowJetPosition_*` simp set. Later uses such as the `lowJetPosition_lowJet` calls in UniformPhasePrimitive.lean would also no longer have to rely on defeq.

evidence.excerpt:
@[simp] lemma lowJetPosition_lowJet (G : Base → Space) (p : Base) :
    lowJetPosition (lowJet G p) = p

@[simp] lemma lowJetPosition_apply (J : LowJet) (i : Fin 2) :
    lowJetPosition J i = J (.inl i) := rfl

def lowJet (G : Base → Space) (p : Base) : LowJet
  | Sum.inl i => p i
